open_points.subject: WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS
open_points.text: Its other constants are scalars and import nothing.
open_points.question: What is the exported type and representation of `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS`, which contains 25 code points and therefore is not plainly one of the seven tables or a scalar?
options: Declare it as an immutable collection of integer code points and exempt it from “other constants are scalars”
Encode the set in one scalar value and require `given_values` to decode it
Add a row model and treat it as an eighth table
open_points.default_guess: Declare `WHITE_SPACE_CODE_POINTS` as an immutable collection of integer code points that imports no model, and revise the scalar claim.

open_points.subject: confirmation transaction and session locks
open_points.text: building that mapping once more inside the confirming transaction, applied only when clean (A16 rule 6), and, in the one transaction `operations` opens
open_points.question: Which module owns the enclosing operation that keeps the import lock and session lock held while `operations` opens the store transaction and `migration_import` rebuilds and applies the mapping?
options: `operations` coordinates the lock scope, transaction and calls
`owner_sessions` exposes an operation executed under both locks, within which `operations` opens the transaction
`migration_import` acquires the session/import locks and performs the transactional work
open_points.default_guess: Have `owner_sessions` expose a scoped operation that holds both locks; `operations` opens the store transaction inside that scope and calls `migration_import`.

open_points.subject: production-id conflict checks during confirmation
open_points.text: the mapping for the picks — rooms, pointers, names and aliases, the Customers it will make, malformed records and conflicting ids (rules 1, 3–5)
open_points.question: Through which owned capabilities does `migration_import` test, inside the confirming transaction, whether production already holds each picked project, room or pointer id?
options: Add transaction-scoped identity lookup capabilities to `projects` and `artifact_pointers`, with `projects` owning room lookup
Let `migration_import` query domain rows directly through `store`
Have `operations` perform all conflict lookups and pass their results to `migration_import`
open_points.default_guess: Expose transaction-scoped conflict lookups from the record-owning modules: project and room ids from `projects`, pointer ids from `artifact_pointers`.
